ValidationRule.description: This validation rule checks required fields values.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified"), IsConverted = TRUE), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Lead Qualified") ), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(CustomerBudget__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(UnitType__c)) ), ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, "Modon - Egypt"), $Profile.Name <> "Modon Egypt - Call Center" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Lead to be Qualified or move forward with Customer Budget and Unit Type fields are required.
